triggers: a kernel on NVIDIA Blackwell GeForce/workstation (RTX PRO 5000 / SM120) risks the '2. Launching stock C1 early without a device-side wait' trap

payload.goal: Avoid a known trap on NVIDIA Blackwell GeForce/workstation (RTX PRO 5000 / SM120): 2. Launching stock C1 early without a device-side wait

problem.statement: SM120 RMSNorm-MLP PDL Pitfalls -- 2. Launching stock C1 early without a device-side wait

payload.attempted: Launch the secondary CUTLASS C1 kernel early on the same stream and assume stream ordering or programmatic serialization protects A/input-scale reads.
payload.lesson: A safely early C1 needs `cudaGridDependencySynchronize()` or an equivalent device-side wait before A/input-scale loads.

established_fact.mechanism: The dependent launch can start before the producer grid fully terminates. That is the point of PDL.

payload.observed: C1 can race `input_fp4` and `input_sf` unless the kernel waits before loading them.
payload.root_cause: The dependent launch can start before the producer grid fully terminates. That is the point of PDL.
